236·x³ + 1.08·v², with no dependence on t and no linear or damping terms in x or v. It fits the training data with NMSE 2.4e-23, which is at machine precision.

The constants are 0.236 on x³ and 1.08 on v². Since v is always positive in the data, v|v| and v² are indistinguishable here, so I used v².
